summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories filed a Form 6-K to disclose a routine grant of stock options to eligible employees under its existing ESOP and ADR stock option schemes. The company approved 8,16,119 Indian stock options and 3,76,115 ADR stock options, each at an exercise price of Rs. 1,293.90 (fair market value), with 100% vesting after 3 years. No acquisition, divestiture, or special situation is involved; this is a standard equity compensation grant. The filing was made under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) and is not a special situation event. No deal terms apply.
